reviewTitle: Great Sound, Non-adjustable ear hooks and terrible charging quality
reviewDescription: To start with the positive, these earbuds have some of the best sound quality I have ever heard. When they work, they are awesome. However, there are two things that make these things a two-star. First, the ear hooks are not adjustable so it makes it hard for them to stay in your ears when you are doing any running, jumping or even lifting. Second, I have had them returned three different times because they will not charge properly. I did all the trouble shooting, talked with customer service and continue to be disappointed with their ability to recharge. If they fixed these two issues, they would have the best earbuds on the market.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 31, 2026
